# Draft:2026 Streamer Awards

| previous = 2025
| main = The Streamer Awards
}}
The 2026 Streamer Awards (also referred to as The 6th Annual Streamer Awards) is the sixth edition of the annual Streamer Awards, honoring the best in live streaming in 2026. The ceremony will be held on November 12, 2026 and will be hosted by QTCinderella and another unannounced host.
The show was announced on April 19, 2026, with more information said to be coming at a later date.
